title: Midrand vs Isando, Kempton Park and Waterfall: Warehouse Guide
contentHtml:
Compare warehouse locations using your delivery routes, staff journeys, building requirements and full occupancy cost. Midrand, Isando, Kempton Park and Waterfall are useful search starting points, but an area name does not establish a building’s capacity, availability or suitability.

This guide forms part of our warehouses to rent in Midrand guide. The examples below distinguish published Midpoint listing information from the checks you need to make before choosing a property.

Start with the exact property and your routes

Midrand and Halfway House

Midpoint is at 162 Tonetti Street, Halfway House, Midrand. Use the estate location and access information to locate the property, then test the routes to your customers, suppliers and staff at your actual operating times. A position between Johannesburg and Pretoria does not guarantee a shorter journey for a particular operation.

Isando and Kempton Park

Do not treat these names as entirely separate markets: Isando addresses can also identify Kempton Park. For example, BidAir Cargo’s official contact page lists its head office in Isando, Kempton Park and a separate cargo-terminal operation at OR Tambo. If airport freight matters to your business, compare the route from each shortlisted building to the terminal or handler you actually use, including access procedures and delivery cut-off times.

Waterfall

Waterfall City’s official industrial overview describes a logistics hub between Johannesburg and Pretoria with purpose-built warehouse and office accommodation. That overview does not establish the specification, asking rent or available space in an individual building. Request a current unit schedule and compare the property with your Midrand shortlist on the same basis.

Use the same comparison brief for every shortlisted warehouse

  1. Delivery routes: record customer stops, supplier collections, airport or freight-terminal requirements, vehicle sizes and operating times. Test the complete journey, including the final approach, gate and loading point.
  2. People and access: assess staff travel, shift times, visitor access, parking allocation and any restrictions on after-hours operations.
  3. Usable space: request an approved rentable-area schedule showing warehouse, office and mezzanine components. Compare the office proportion with the staff and workflow you need; use our office-to-warehouse ratio guide.
  4. Technical requirements: distinguish eaves height from usable clearance, yard area from vehicle turning space, and electrical supply from backup allocation. Check loading doors, floor loading, fire provision and permitted activity against the selected unit. See the warehouse specification checklist.
  5. Condition and handover: separate existing accommodation from a proposed conversion. Agree required works, responsibilities, approvals and a credible occupation programme.
  6. Comparable costs: obtain written quotes for the same area basis, term and occupation date, with VAT treatment, recoveries, utilities, parking, deposit, escalation and required fit-out identified.

What can you compare at Midpoint?

The live warehouse comparison shows current published areas, asking rates and availability. Listing statements are not independent measurements, engineering certification or confirmed handover dates. Examples checked on 19 October 2026:

  • 6 Weaver Avenue: published total area of 11,443 m². Its description identifies a 10,150 m² warehouse component, 1,293 m² offices and a separate 5,800 m² yard. It also states 15 m height to eaves, floor loading of 3,000 kg/m² and a 2.5 MVA power figure. Confirm the current/proposed scope, usable height, engineering limits and allocated supply; the power figure does not establish generator coverage.
  • 1 Kingfisher Avenue: published area of 4,199.39 m², a description stating 4-metre clearance and advertised availability of 1 January 2027. Confirm measured clearance, works and the agreed occupation date.
  • 2 Kingfisher Avenue: a conversion opportunity with an unresolved area conflict. The numeric field gives 3,849 m², while the description states 3,300 m². Request an approved area schedule and current/proposed plans. No monthly-rent estimate is provided here until the area and quote basis are reconciled.

Use the linked listings for current asking rates and availability rather than treating this dated article as a live vacancy schedule. Shared estate facilities do not establish a specific unit’s service allocation, operating status or charges.

Compare the full quote before choosing a node

For an area-based quote, monthly base rent is the agreed rentable area multiplied by the agreed monthly rate per square metre. Add the confirmed charges and required works to build your budget. A lower advertised rate does not establish a lower total occupancy cost. No verified like-for-like market rental comparison between these nodes is established here.

If your requirement is primarily occasional storage rather than daily receiving, picking and dispatch, read the business storage versus warehouse guide before shortlisting. The current Midpoint warehouse schedule is not evidence of small self-storage availability.

Arrange a viewing with a clear operational brief

Send your required area, warehouse/office split, vehicles and daily movements, equipment loads, target occupation date and budget. Ask for the dimensioned floor plan, specification schedule and complete quote for the particular property.

Discuss your warehouse requirement with Midpoint leasing, or compare current Midpoint opportunities.

Frequently asked questions

Is Midrand always better than Isando or Kempton Park?

No. Test the actual properties against your customer, supplier, staff and freight routes. The right choice depends on those requirements and the building itself.

Does a Waterfall or Midrand address guarantee modern warehouse specifications?

No. Obtain the current specification and plans for the selected unit. An area description cannot confirm height, loading, power, backup coverage or occupation readiness.

Can I compare rent using only the advertised rate per square metre?

Use an agreed area basis and compare the full written cost breakdown, works and term. Withhold calculations where the area is disputed, as at 2 Kingfisher.
